subject: A New Alzheimer's Target: How a Broken Enzyme Clogs Mitochondria and Drives Dementia
script: From Agewell Brief: A New Alzheimer's Target: How a Broken Enzyme Clogs Mitochondria and Drives Dementia. Swiss researchers have identified a vicious cycle of protein aggregation that starves neurons of energy and fuels amyloid buildup. An experimental compound breaks the loop—and hints at broader effects on aging. Alzheimer's disease has resisted every attempt at a cure. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
